summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release with Q2 2026 production results (72,217 gold equivalent ounces) and updates on growth initiatives (Séguéla plant expansion studies, Diamba Sud feasibility study) and capital returns ($80.2M in share repurchases at avg. $9.32/share under a normal course issuer bid). The filing is a routine operational and financial update, not a special situation. It contains no M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other event-driven catalyst. As a foreign private issuer 6-K, this is analogous to a domestic 8-K earnings release.
